input: Should we cache the product catalogue or query it every time?
context: The catalogue has 20,000 items and changes twice a day.
constraints: Prices must be up to date within 10 minutes

examples.solution: Yes, in Redis with a TTL.

episodic_memory.content: Last month the database was slow at peak time

procedural_memory.name: Decide on caching
procedural_memory.content: Compare read rate, size and staleness tolerance

history.content: I need help with an architecture choice.
